name: paseo-command
description: Paseo Command: the Paseo fleet drawn as the Atlas world (SpriteKit in the macOS app)

scripts.app:install: npm --prefix rendering install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.app:build: npm run render:test && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.app:update: npm run app:build && npm run app:bundle-server && npm run native:build
scripts.native:test: node native/scripts/test-native.mjs && node native/scripts/test-bundle.mjs && node native/scripts/test-conquer.mjs
scripts.secrets:scan: if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null; then gitleaks git --log-opts=--all --redact=100 --no-banner; else echo 'gitleaks is not installed (brew install gitleaks); skipping the credential scan.'; fi
scripts.check: npm run public:check -- --history && npm run secrets:scan && npm run app:test && npm run app:build && npm run native:test
